description: Database view exposing factory trading margin report data.
business_purpose: Used to track and report factory trading margin report records, including amounts and quantities, for the Factory & Inventory area.
record_granularity: One row represents one record returned by the factory trading margin report view.

business_rules: InvoiceDate is the preferred date column for period-based reporting.
Use TotalSheet / avg(fc.PercentageValue) for monetary or quantity totals.
Vw_FactoryTradingMarginReport is a database view: it is read-only and its rows are computed, so apply filters and a LIMIT when querying.

common_metrics.name: Average Before Gst Before Factory Trading Price

common_queries: Factory Trading Margin Report by month

known_issues: BeforeGstBeforeFactoryTradingPrice, BeforeGstAfterFactoryTradingPrice, BeforeGstAfterDealerDiscount, TradingMargin are stored as floating point, so sums can carry small rounding differences.
avg(fc.PercentageValue), TotalSheet, BeforeGstBeforeFactoryTradingPrice, BeforeGstAfterFactoryTradingPrice are nullable; use COALESCE when summing or comparing.
Views expose no primary key or nullability guarantees; rows may repeat depending on the view definition.

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name Vw_FactoryTradingMarginReport (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Use SUM(TotalSheet) for totals of total sheet.
This is a view; always apply filters and a LIMIT, as it may be expensive to scan.
